label: Full Day
desc: Exactly "86400", the number of seconds in a day.

label: Exact Munchausen
desc: Exactly "3435": 3³ + 4⁴ + 3³ + 5⁵ = 3435, each digit raised to its own power gives the number back (a Munchausen number).

label: Exact Pythag
desc: Exactly "91625": 9 + 16 = 25, the squares of the 3-4-5 right triangle.

label: Exact Fibonacci
desc: Exactly "112358": 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, each number is the sum of the two before.

label: Perigee
desc: Exactly "363104": the closest the Moon gets to Earth, in km.

label: Apogee
desc: Exactly "405696": the farthest the Moon gets from Earth, in km.

label: Moon Distance
desc: Exactly "384400": the average distance from Earth to the Moon, in km.

label: True Spartan
desc: Exactly "711117": a Natural and a Spartan in one number.

label: Exact Halving
desc: Exactly "168421": 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, halving all the way down.
Exactly "852655", the number from the famous short.

label: Exact 92
desc: Exactly 92: the curse in its purest form.

label: Cyclic Number
desc: Exactly 142857: multiply it by 2 to 6 and its digits only rotate.

label: Around the Clock
desc: Exactly 24: every hour of the day.

label: Summer Break
desc: Exactly 104: the days of summer vacation.

label: Full Circle
desc: Exactly 360: a full turn. Nailed it!

label: 4 Consecutive Numbers
desc: The entire number splits into four consecutive integers in order.

label: Ouroboros
desc: A number raised to itself: nⁿ (1¹, 2², ... 7⁷).

label: Sequence (6)
desc: Contains a sequence of 6 consecutive digits.

label: Narcissistic
desc: Each digit raised to the number of digits, all added up, gives the number back: 153 = 1³ + 5³ + 3³ (only 11 of them).

label: Beverly Hills
desc: Contains "90210", the famous Beverly Hills zip code.

label: Leap Day
desc: Reads as February 29 of a leap year: 0229YY, 2902YY or YY0229, like 022924 (rolled as 22924), 290224 or 240229.

label: Cascade
desc: Every digit increases by exactly 1 from the previous.

label: Fibonacci Number
desc: Part of the golden ratio sequence found in nature.

label: Waterfall
desc: Every digit decreases by exactly 1 from the previous.

label: 4 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
desc: The entire number splits into four consecutive integers, but not in order.

label: Straight Flush
desc: Contains 5 consecutive same-parity digits (02468, 13579, or their reverse).

label: Spy Number
desc: The sum of its digits equals the product of its digits.

label: Pythagorean
desc: Read as three pairs AB CD EF, AB² + CD² = EF²: 102426 is 10² + 24² = 26². A 5-digit roll starts with 0, so 30405 is 3² + 4² = 5² (only 100 of them).

label: Palindromic Prime
desc: A prime of 2 or more digits that reads the same both ways, like 94049.

label: Even Spacing
desc: All digits are evenly spaced in an arithmetic sequence.

label: 3 Consecutive Numbers
desc: The entire number splits into three consecutive integers in order.

label: Strobogrammatic
desc: Looks the same when rotated 180 degrees.

label: Straight
desc: Contains a sequence of 5 consecutive digits (ascending or descending).

label: Halving
desc: Contains "8421": every digit is half of the one before.
Contains "2099": even further in the future.

label: Taxicab
desc: Contains "1729": the smallest sum of two cubes in two ways (1³ + 12³ = 9³ + 10³).

label: Moon Landing
desc: Contains "1969": the year of the first steps on the Moon.

label: 3 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
desc: The entire number splits into three consecutive integers, but not in order.

label: American
desc: Contains "1776", the year of the Declaration of Independence.

label: Ascension
desc: Every digit is strictly larger than the previous.

label: Crescendo
desc: Splits into three or more numbers with a constant ratio.

label: Countdown Shuffle
desc: The digits of 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, each once, in any order.

label: Framed Pair
desc: A 4-digit number where the middle two digits match each other but differ from both end digits.

label: Framed Triple
desc: A triple in the middle, bookended by different digits.

label: Framed Quad
desc: Four of a kind in the middle, bookended by different digits.

label: Decay
desc: Every digit is strictly smaller than the previous.

label: Echo
desc: The first half repeats as the second half.

label: Pronic Number
desc: The product of two consecutive integers (n * n+1).

label: Even Spacing (Absolute)
desc: All digits have the same absolute spacing (e.g., ±2 each time).

label: Firefly
desc: One unique digit among identical others.

label: Exact Natural
desc: Exactly "711": seven and eleven, the two rolls that win on the first throw of the dice.

label: Shifted Echo
desc: The second half is the first half with every digit 1 lower or 1 higher, like 456345.

label: 2 Consecutive Numbers
desc: The entire number splits into two consecutive integers.

label: Odd Abundant
desc: An odd number smaller than the sum of its divisors (1,996 of them, the first is 945).

label: Palindrome
desc: Reads the same forwards and backwards.

label: Turtle
desc: All consecutive digits differ by at most 1.

label: Heavy
desc: The sum of its digits exceeds 45.

label: Contiguous Full House
desc: Contains a contiguous set of three adjacent to a contiguous set of two.

label: 9 to 5
desc: Contains "925": working 9 to 5, like the Dolly Parton song.

label: Sequence (4)
desc: Contains a sequence of 4 consecutive digits.

label: Player 456
desc: Contains "456", the most famous player number.

label: LOL
desc: Contains "707": LOL, upside down on a calculator.

label: Fibonacci Slice (3)
desc: Contains "112": 1, 1, 2, the start of the Fibonacci sequence.

label: Bee
desc: Contains "338": BEE, upside down on a calculator.

label: Huge Square
desc: Contains a 5-digit perfect square (like 15625, 99856). Only the biggest one counts.

label: Scramble
desc: All digits form a consecutive sequence when sorted.

label: Prime Digits
desc: Every digit is a prime digit: 2, 3, 5 or 7.

label: Metronome
desc: Splits into three or more numbers with a constant difference.

label: Framed Double
desc: Two pairs in the middle, bookended by different digits.

label: Trilogy
desc: Six digits that split into three 2-digit pieces, each one a badge number on its own, like 51 · 92 · 25 (Area 51, Exact 92, Quarter-Century). Pieces that count: 21, 24, 25, 41, 42, 47, 49, 50, 51, 55, 61, 64, 67, 69, 75, 82, 86, 92, 97, 99.

label: Paired Bookends
desc: Starts with a pair and ends with a different pair.

label: Three Pair
desc: Contains three distinct pairs of matching digits.

label: Bookends
desc: The first two digits match the last two.

label: Mirror Bookends
desc: First two digits are reversed as the last two.

label: Happy Prime
desc: A happy number that is also prime.

label: Equation
desc: Insert one of + − × ÷ and an equals sign to make a true equation.

label: Quantum Chaos
desc: A prime number of 4 digits or more where no digit repeats.

label: Natural
desc: Contains "711": seven and eleven, the two rolls that win on the first throw of the dice.

label: Full Stack
desc: Contains "64": a full stack of blocks.

label: Mountain
desc: Digits ascend to a peak and then descend.

label: Double Hop
desc: A digit appears at every other position (3 times).

label: Big Square
desc: Contains a 4-digit perfect square (like 1024, 7744). Only the biggest one counts.

label: Valley
desc: Digits descend to a trough and then ascend.

label: Alternator
desc: Digits strictly alternate between even and odd.

label: Flush
desc: All digits are either all even or all odd.

label: Feather
desc: The sum of its digits is less than 15.

label: Full House
desc: Contains a set of three and a set of two.

label: Pocket Mirror
desc: Contains a palindrome of 4 or more digits.

label: Snake Eyes
desc: Contains a single pair of ones and no other pairs.

label: Area 51
desc: Contains "51": the truth is out there.

label: Angel Number
desc: Contains "82": abundance and harmony, in numerology.

label: Balanced
desc: Sum of first half of digits equals sum of second half.

label: Rhyme
desc: Contains the same 2+ digit substring twice.

label: Sequence (3)
desc: Contains a sequence of 3 consecutive digits.

label: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Contains)
desc: Contains two adjacent substrings that are consecutive integers.

label: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Nearby)
desc: Contains two non-adjacent substrings that are consecutive integers.

label: Mesa
desc: Digits rise to a peak, then fall (flat stretches allowed).

label: Square Inside
desc: Contains a 3-digit perfect square (like 144, 625). Only the biggest one counts.

label: Canyon
desc: Digits fall to a floor, then rise (flat stretches allowed).

label: Harshad Number
desc: Divisible by the sum of its own digits.

label: Equilibrium
desc: The first and last digits are identical.

label: Sandwich
desc: First and last digits match, with at least one different digit between them.

label: Hills
desc: Digits strictly alternate between rising and falling.

label: Happy
desc: A happy number: replace it by the sum of the squares of its digits, again and again, and you reach 1.

label: Mini Scramble
desc: Contains 3 or more adjacent digits that form a run when sorted.

label: Gap One
desc: The first and last digits differ by exactly 1.

label: Little Square
desc: Contains a 2-digit perfect square (like 16, 49, 81). Only the biggest one counts.

label: Two Pair
desc: Contains two distinct pairs of matching digits.

label: Dunes
desc: Rises and falls keep alternating (flat stretches allowed).

label: Hopscotch
desc: A digit appears at every other position (2 times).

label: Grounded
desc: The first digit is smaller than the last.

label: Contiguous Pair
desc: Contains a contiguous pair of matching digits.

label: Liftoff
desc: The first digit is larger than the last.

label: Neighbors
desc: Contains two digits that are adjacent in value.

label: Pair
desc: Contains a pair of matching digits.

label: Contiguous Tens
desc: Ten identical digits: the whole number is one digit repeated.

label: Sequence (7)
desc: Contains a sequence of 7 consecutive digits.

label: Sequence (8)
desc: Contains a sequence of 8 consecutive digits.

label: Sequence (9)
desc: Contains a sequence of 9 consecutive digits.

label: Sequence (10)
desc: A sequence of 10 consecutive digits: only 9876543210 has one.

label: 32-bit Limit
desc: Exactly 2147483647 (2³¹ − 1): the biggest number a 32-bit signed integer can hold.

label: Mersenne Prime
desc: A prime that is a power of two minus one: 3, 7, 31, 127, 8191, 131071, 524287 or 2147483647.

label: Pandigital
desc: Uses all ten digits, each one exactly once.
